meta.note: Reference data. Markdown rules are authoritative. Items marked provisional should remain easy to tune.

personalGear.name: Trap
personalGear.effect: Use with Rabbit Field Gather: 2 Food; Rabbit Field unavailable next Day.

personalGear.name: Backpack
personalGear.effect: When drawn/readied, draw 1 additional hand card.

personalGear.name: Map
personalGear.effect: Once/day Explore: draw 2 Locations, choose 1, bottom the other.

personalGear.name: Fishing Rod
personalGear.effect: Use with Pond Gather: 3 Food; Pond unavailable next Day.

personalGear.name: Top Hat
personalGear.effect: When drawn, permanently remove 1 Fear from hand/played/discard; do not search draw pile.

personalGear.name: Spear
personalGear.effect: Combat Prepare becomes 3 Combat total; may satisfy Spear Location effects.

personalGear.name: Torch
personalGear.effect: Protection Prepare becomes 3 Protection total; may satisfy light Location effects.

personalGear.name: Log Suit
personalGear.effect: Prevent 1 Health loss to owner per use.

personalGear.name: Small Campfire
personalGear.effect: Action: +2 Protection tonight; chosen survivor ignores next 1 Fear gained tonight.

personalGear.name: Garland
personalGear.effect: Craft: remove 1 Fear. Later draw: action to remove 1 Fear, then remove Garland from game.

campImprovements.name: Fire Pit
campImprovements.effect: At Night spend 1 Wood; if fueled +2 Protection.

campImprovements.name: Lean-To
campImprovements.effect: First healing Recover/day heals 3 instead of 1.

campImprovements.name: Tent
campImprovements.effect: Once/day one survivor spends 1 action + 1 Food to remove up to 3 Fear from own hand/played/discard.

foodInfrastructure.name: Transplanted Berry Bush
foodInfrastructure.requires: Ready Shovel + unused Berry Grove transplant opportunity + Work
